title: A card is never refused, and a new bank account takes over
assertion: Through the routes on the simulator, an organization with only a card on file chooses the annual plan and its invoice is paid by card, and an audit invoice issued to it is paid by card; once it adds a bank account, the next open invoice it pays is charged to the bank account; and on the simulator itself, a renewal of its plan is charged to the bank account, even when the subscription carried the card as its own default
noFileReason: A synthetic organization pays through the routes on the local simulator, by the simulator’s test card and bank account, and the simulator renews its plan; no file.
